# Security Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that security and privacy requirements are complete, quantified and threat-traced.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all URL rejection classes enumerated, each with a machine-readable reason? [Completeness, Spec §FR-SHR-002, §FR-SHR-004; data-model.md §4] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Are secret-handling requirements specified for logs, audit, errors and the repository, each with scan-based verification? [Completeness, Spec §NFR-SEC-002, §NFR-SEC-004; CON V] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the threat model requirement list each threat from NFR-SEC-003 (open redirect, enumeration, injection, abuse volume, approval spoofing) with a control or an accepted risk? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-SEC-003; Plan §8] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Are audit-tampering and change-set-tampering threats specified with controls? [Coverage, ADR-008; ADR-006] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is dependency-vulnerability and secret scanning required as a release-readiness condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-GOV-012] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK006 Are error-response contents restricted (no stack traces, secrets or persistence identifiers)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-SHR-018] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the URL scheme allow-list specified as an enumerated set with a secure default? [Clarity, Spec §FR-SHR-003, §A-002] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the maximum destination URL length quantified? [Measurability, PVT-010] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Is internal and local address handling specified, including the accepted residual risk for DNS names that resolve to internal addresses? [Clarity, PD-001; Plan §8] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Are self-referential destination rules defined for every host the shortener is reachable on (dev, staging, configured aliases)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-SHR-004] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK011 Are enumeration-resistance requirements quantified (code space, non-sequential generation, no existence hints to unauthenticated callers)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-SHR-006, §FR-SHR-019; ADR-014] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is rate limiting quantified, keyed and specified with the response returned when the limit is exceeded? [Measurability, Spec §FR-SHR-017; PVT-011; A-015] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK013 Is API key storage specified (hashed at rest, non-secret key identity used for audit)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GOV-013; ADR-010] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the scan pass threshold quantified? [Measurability, PVT-012] [Mandatory]

## Scenario and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Is unauthenticated redirect volume recorded in the threat list as an accepted risk, with its rationale and backlog item BL-13? [Assumption, Spec §NFR-SEC-003 (CR-003); CON V] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the outcome specified when the vulnerability scanner cannot run (FAIL, never PASS)? [Edge Case, policy-set.v1.yaml SEC-003; Human Gate 4 ruling 5] [D09] [Mandatory]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK017 Are key issuance, rotation and revocation limitations documented as accepted risks? [Assumption, HD-003] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the local-trust assumption for the key file and workstation stated? [Assumption, ADR-010] [Optional]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
